info.title: BioAvanceD API
info.description: BioAvanceD backend API (RNF006 C2, #1325). This spec covers only the mounts listed in x-covered-mounts; the rest of the API is not yet documented here. Every response body is JSON with a boolean success; a failure carries error and, often, message. Outside the test environment every route sits behind the global rate limiter and /api/auth also behind the auth limiter, and a request over either limit answers 429.

post.summary: Ingest one record: validate it, then persist it or quarantine it, and audit the outcome (RF029)
post.description: Gates: authenticate, applied to the whole router, and requireRole(3, 4). Every outcome is audited, the refusals included.

entityType.description: The ingestion target. One the ingestion does not support, or one stored outside MongoDB, answers 422.

payload.description: The record, in the target's canonical shape.

provenance.description: The provenance envelope; a missing field quarantines the record.

idempotencyKey.description: A repeated key answers the first call's outcome again.

200.description: An idempotent replay of an accepted record: the first call's result.

201.description: Accepted and persisted, with its outbox event.

403.description: requireRole(3, 4) refused, or error INGESTION_OUT_OF_SCOPE: a field of the record is outside the caller's organization scope.

422.description: error INGESTION_QUARANTINED: the record is quarantined and details lists each violation, also on the replay of a quarantined key; or error INGESTION_TARGET_UNSUPPORTED, INGESTION_STORE_UNSUPPORTED or BARCODE_PERSONAL_DATA.

500.description: error INGESTION_FAILED: an unexpected failure, audited.

503.description: The database is not available, or error CANONICAL_RELEASE_NOT_ACTIVE: the canonical model release in force is absent or not active.

post.summary: Promote a reference release (RF028 AC8)
post.description: Gates: authenticate, requireRole(4). A refused promotion names its reason in error.

409.description: Refused; error names the reason: release_not_approved, promotion_in_progress, approved_run_not_found, coverage_manifest_missing, coverage_manifest_invalid, coverage_incomplete, quality_assessment_missing or quality_assessment_failed, or any other reason the service returns.

post.summary: Roll a dataset back to its previous reference release (RF028 AC9)
post.description: Gates: authenticate, requireRole(4). A refused rollback names its reason in error.

409.description: Refused; error names the reason: no_previous_release or previous_release_not_found, or any other reason the service returns.

get.summary: A sample file as a FHIR DocumentReference (RF011 AC4)
get.description: Gates, in order: authenticate, requireOrganizationScope, requireDataExportAllowed, enforceCommercialConsent({ resolveSampleId: (req) => req.params.specimenId }), the last on the uso_comercial scope. Then the file, the sample, the link between them and the sample's organization are checked.

parameters.name: specimenId
parameters.description: The sample, by any of its ids.

200.description: The DocumentReference as a FHIR R4 export.

data.description: The DocumentReference: standard, fhirVersion, mapping, mappingReleaseId, conformanceClaimed, generatedAt, roundTripLimitations and the FHIR R4 bundle.

400.description: The file is not linked to this sample.

403.description: The caller has no organization assigned (requireOrganizationScope), data export is disabled in the LGPD configuration (requireDataExportAllowed), the sample's consent does not allow commercial use (enforceCommercialConsent), or the sample belongs to another organization.

404.description: The file (an invalid, unknown or deleted fileID) or the sample is not found.

500.description: Internal error, or requireOrganizationScope found no database.

bearerAuth.description: Authorization: Bearer <access token>, the token login and refresh return.

BadRequest.description: Invalid or missing input, or the operation failed.

Unauthorized.description: No, invalid or expired token or session, or an inactive account; on login, refused credentials.

Forbidden.description: Access denied: the permission or role gate refused, the role assignment expired, or MFA setup is pending.

UnprocessableEntity.description: Validation failed; details lists each reason.
